episodes.synopsis: With retreat an impossibility, Bell’s party fight for their lives when a Floor Boss spawns early. However, they are all adventurers; they will not die so easily.
episodes.title: Amphisbaena | A Song of Despair

episodes.synopsis: Critically wounded and trapped within the dungeon’s darkened depths, Bell and Ryu’s adventure is over. Their fight for survival has now begun.
episodes.title: Morgue | Victim

episodes.synopsis: The boss fight extracts a heavy toll on the party, and they must make a choice. If they go one way, they will live. But if they go the other? They will die.
episodes.title: Daphne Lauros | Friend

episodes.synopsis: The party narrowly survived, and now they must search for their missing friends. However, they’re facing more than just monsters; they’re fighting the Dungeon itself.
episodes.title: Ignis | Flame

episodes.synopsis: Bell and Ryu must cast reservations aside in the face of death. Meanwhile, Welf faces a trial by fire he cannot fail; lives are at stake.
episodes.title: Welf Crozzo | Shikou

episodes.synopsis: Bell and Ryu’s relationship deepens as the trauma of the Deep Floors pushes them past their limits. They have each other, and that is the only reason they’re both still alive.
episodes.title: White Palace | White Labyrinth

episodes.synopsis: Hope glimmers in the darkness; the Xenos appear in the party’s hour of need, and Bell and Ryu make steady progress despite all odds. They may all survive this after all.
episodes.title: Desperate | Dungeon Do-or-Die Time

episodes.synopsis: Their luck couldn’t last forever; Bell and Ryu must cross the Colosseum, where monsters constantly respawn. In the end, they may face an impossible choice…
episodes.title: Colosseum | Combat Arena

episodes.synopsis: It is too late for the Astrea Familia. Their story ends in tragedy, and this is the tale of how Ryu's life changed forever on that dark day.
episodes.title: Astrea Familia | Heroic Death

episodes.synopsis: Ryu’s feelings for Bell have changed in a way she cannot quite place. All she knows is that she cannot lose him; she just cannot.
episodes.title: Daydream | A Sweet Lie

episodes.synopsis: After five years of grief, guilt and pain, Ryu finally faces a new path—a new justice. The Juggernaut should beware.
episodes.title: Luvia | Starry Flower
